overrides.reason: DLAQR0 caps its aggressive-early-deflation window at NW <= LWORK/2 and its simultaneous shifts at NS <= 2*LWORK/3, and DLAQR3 and DLAQR5 then pick their block sizes from the WORK they are given, so the reference's own QR iteration depends on LWORK: below its documented max(1,N) (which it neither checks nor needs) it is accepted but takes another path, and at LWORK = 1 or 2 (no window, no shifts) it makes no progress and returns INFO = IHI with H and Z partly reduced. Compiled LAPACK 3.12.0 does this too: N = 140 and 300 (random Hessenberg and the cyclic shift) at LWORK = 1, 2 return INFO = N, at LWORK = 3 INFO = 139/284/300, at LWORK >= 4 INFO = 0, never writing past WORK(LWORK). The Schur form and vectors are unique only up to the order and signs the path picks. The module's tests check LWORK = 1 (INFO = N, as the reference) and a few elements past the blocking threshold (all eigenvalues found) (ticket 0016).

set.params.H.workDependent: the QR iteration's path depends on LWORK (AED window <= LWORK/2, shifts <= 2*LWORK/3), as the reference's does; with 1 or 2 elements it makes no progress (INFO > 0)
